scope: Read-only coverage review; only this report was written. No concurrent Lean build or Rust export was started.

acceptance_snapshot.qualification: Successful strict run predates the currently running clean build; parent will rerun strict acceptance afterward.

checks: Direct path imports from original poseidon_97 production modules.
Actual DctqStepCircuit::synthesize invoked on 16x160 RGB PreparedStep.
TraceCS and separately synthesized plain ShapeCS rows and output-wire maps compared for equality.
Exact regenerated JSON values compared with step.json, trace.json and parameters.json under check-export; no export baseline replaced.
97630 constraints, 97634 auxiliary variables, one ShapeCS input, and challenge output alias asserted.
Source manifest rechecked before and after exporter execution.
original_export.trust_boundary: Rust/compiler/environment, exporter and source-to-artifact/import mapping remain the accepted extraction boundary; no claim of Rust compiler or Nova correctness.

checks: All 97630 rows and 7680 pixel-wire mappings validated.
Field modulus, counts, canonical coefficients, strictly ordered in-range indices, incoming/outgoing maps checked.
generate_rows.py --check reconstructs the lossless 32-bit-word encoding and compares exact ExportedData.lean contents.
Parameter and all seven certificate-generator --check commands are included in strict verification.
Certification examples require the unchanged original universal target propositions.
Completeness constructs a Seed assignment extended by the verified actual suffix program and covers both the entire byte prefix and entire suffix.
ConnectedSteps explicitly connects adjacent incoming/outgoing states; connected360 is the 360-step specialization.
excluded_claims: Nova folding or augmented circuit verification

checks: Transitive #print axioms output required for each exact expected theorem name.
Any unexpected axiom, missing theorem, duplicate/mismatched report, or Lean failure rejects the audit.
Only after Certification build, full audit and source recheck can verify.py write certified=true.

forbidden_source_scan.scope: All local lean/*.lean and lean/CircuitCorrectness/**/*.lean; dependency/toolchain caches excluded.
forbidden_source_scan.method: Nested comments and quoted strings removed by scripts/clean_build.py uncomment; regex token scan of remaining Lean source.
forbidden_source_scan.qualification: This review supplies the lexical scan. verify.py currently enforces the transitive axiom whitelist but has no separate lexical-scan step.

mutation_and_differential_tests.output_mapping_test: validate_artifacts.py output_wire mutation rejects an altered exported output map.
mutation_and_differential_tests.qualification: Regression evidence is explicitly separate from universal Lean certification.

source_preservation.limitation: The baseline inventories original poseidon_97 and nova60/Nova source files plus their Cargo/build files. It does not independently fingerprint poseidon_97_180 or every other proof-project directory; do not describe the 106-file check as a whole-workspace fingerprint comparison.

checks: Certification uses committed local Lean data, mathematical image/state functions and cached pinned Lean/mathlib dependencies.
No private image or Nova prover invocation is required by the standalone Certification target.
Clean runner deletes only lean/.lake/build, preserves cached packages/toolchain, fingerprints every local module/configuration, and records wall time and child high-water RSS.
standalone_and_clean_build.qualification: Do not use the running report as final successful clean-build measurement. RSS is maximum accounted child high-water mark, not total simultaneous-process memory.

findings_and_followups.action: After the active clean build, add these names to ordinary audit.py THEOREMS, run audit, and rerun strict verification. No mathematical theorem change is requested.
